selected_composite.modifications: Cropped panels, uniformly resized, placed side by side on white canvas; descriptive English headers added. Original axes, ticks, source panel labels and curve annotations retained. No traces/data redrawn.
selected_composite.observed_visual_check: Inspected source PDF pages3/4 at300dpi and final composite at original resolution. Both axes, OFF/ON, 0/60/120s, same-chip/4m/80km labels fully visible.
selected_composite.meaning: Left is detected residual-pump relative optical power versus time, a phase-sensitive feedback signal; it is not direct phase on the y-axis. Right is Monte Carlo reconstructed-fidelity distributions from measured coincidence data, not 20,000 separately run physical experiments. For 80km, count noise is modeled as Poissonian.
selected_composite.claims: An actively stabilized 80km dual-core spool joins two silicon photonic chips; measured tomographic state fidelity85.7±0.2%. The two panels characterize control and end-to-end state quality, not a completed quantum repeater or distributed gate.
